Elder M. Russell Ballard of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles explained that church leaders felt it was important that families and individuals reconsider their approach to the Sabbath day. “Our whole desire is that throughout the church, we focus our Sabbath day worship on the Lord,” he said. (“Church Leaders Call for Better Observance of Sabbath Day,” Newsroom of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, June 30, 2015, accessed May 2, 2016,mormonnewsroom.org.)

M. Russell Ballard joined the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles in 1985. Donald L. Hallstrom became a member of the Quorum of the Seventy in 2000 and a member of the Presidency of the Seventy in 2009. Dean M. Davies became second counselor in the Presiding Bishopric in 2012 and first counselor in 2015.

Burton and her fellow board members taught workshops from morning to night for three days during the week before general conference. They taught ideas for teaching lessons to children, for teaching songs to children, and for doing both in Spanish. (Burton, interview, 5–6.)
